title: Fabrication of Detectors and Transistors on High-Resistivity Silicon
version: 1988-06. Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory report LBL-25520, archived by DOE OSTI as record 6840495. OSTI API metadata gives a June 1988 report date.
lineage: Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory report LBL-25520, archived by DOE OSTI as record 6840495. OSTI API metadata gives a June 1988 report date.

passages.note: The preprint already reports fabricated low-leakage silicon p-i-n diodes and p-channel MOSFETs on the same wafer, and explains the role of backside gettering in making the fabrication compatible with conventional integrated circuits.
